sen2018.source: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, Precinct-Level Returns 2018 (doi:10.7910/DVN/NVQYMG), summed to counties (medsl-2018-county-senate-governor-house.csv). Statewide Republican and Democratic sums match the FEC 2018 compilation within 0.05 percent in 27 of 33 states; Indiana and New Jersey run about 1.5 percent short; Connecticut and New York count candidates across fusion lines.
notes: CA: no Democrat-vs-Republican race; no data
MN: special election on the same ballot left out
MS: special election on the same ballot left out
VT: no Democrat-vs-Republican race; no data
